summary: The mobile menu root panel achieves a very high visual similarity (99.4% visual match, 94.4% overall style match). The major structural elements are all present and correctly positioned: Ofertas CTA teal bar, 6 navigation items with chevrons, 4 institutional icon cards, and extra links section. Key differences are minor: (1) Ofertas bar has slightly different width/margins, (2) nav items are slightly taller due to more padding, (3) nav item order differs (content issue), (4) font-weight differences on Ofertas link and nav items, (5) extra links use slightly smaller/different color text. No blocking issues found.
recommendation: PASS - Score exceeds 95% threshold at visual level. Minor CSS tweaks recommended for polish: reduce nav item padding to match source height, adjust Ofertas link font-weight to 400, and consider matching extra link font-size to 16px. The nav item ordering is a content issue to be addressed in the CMS.
